initial_requirements: The National Library of Medicine needs a digital repository for collection materials produced by existing and future digitization projects. Members of the public and NIH staff should be able to discover and view permitted materials, while authorized library staff need to create and maintain metadata, ingest or update digital objects, and manage their long-term preservation. Access may vary according to rights and user circumstances.

turns.interviewer_utterance: What are the primary goals for this repository, and which stakeholder roles will use or manage it, including any distinct responsibilities or permissions for public users, NIH staff, and library staff?
turns.interviewee_utterance:
The main goal is to provide a single digital repository for NLM’s digitized collection materials so they can be preserved long term and made discoverable and accessible where rights allow. It should support both existing digitization projects and future ones, with reliable metadata management, ingestion of digital objects, and controlled access based on rights and user type.
Public users and NIH staff should be able to search, discover, and view permitted materials, though some items may be restricted depending on rights or circumstances. Library staff will be the primary managers of the system, handling metadata creation and maintenance, ingesting and updating digital objects, and overseeing preservation and access settings.

slots.name: project_goals
slots.value: Provide a single digital repository for NLM digitized collection materials that supports long-term preservation, discovery, and access where rights allow, for both existing and future digitization projects.

slots.name: stakeholder_roles

slots.name: functional_needs
slots.value: Support metadata management, ingestion and updating of digital objects, search and discovery, viewing of permitted materials, controlled access based on rights and user type, and long-term preservation.

slots.name: business_rules
slots.value: Access to materials must be controlled based on rights and user circumstances, with only permitted materials available to public users and NIH staff.

slots.name: data_entities
slots.value: Digitized collection materials, metadata, digital objects, rights/access settings.

slots.name: constraints
slots.value: Access may vary according to rights and user circumstances; some items may be restricted.

slots.name: quality_concerns
slots.value: Reliable metadata management and long-term preservation.

slots.name: boundary_conditions
